newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Sasib H1 96 oper profit up 117 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Sasib H1 96 oper profit up 117 pct.

text.p: Italian engineering group Sasib Spa, part of Carlo De Benedetti's Cir industrial holding, reported first half 1996 operating profit of 32.8 billion lire ($21.5 million) against 15.1 billion in the same 1995 period.

Consolidated sales revenue was 749 billion lire against 640.5 billion but total order book worth was five percent down at 1.21 trillion lire and pre-tax net profit was slightly lower at 48.41 billion lire versus 48.99 billion.

The company said in a statement that 87.6 billion of the first half revenues, helped by the lira's strength, came from activities abroad. But new orders, worth 593.3 billion lire against 779 billion, had been impacted by a downturn in the railway sector in North America, and the bakery and packaging sectors.
The rise in operating profit was helped by a particularly strong trend in the beverage sector, as well as better performances in the tobacco, food and European railway business areas.
"Forecasts for the full 1996 year are positive and we expect better results than those for 1995," the statement said.
Sasib reported 1995 pre-tax profit of 81.95 billion lire, operating profit of 52.15 billion and consolidated sales of 1.48 trillion lire.
